text:
Maria D: Quick design q — new "Export selections" modal on Vectors > Preview. Trying to land copy and keyboard flow before dev handoff. Thoughts?

Akshay: Nice, can you paste current copy?

Maria D: Sure:
"Export selections"
Format: CSV / JSON
Include: vectors, ids, score
Buttons: [Cancel] [Export]

Lena: Two quick things: rename "Include" to "Columns" (clearer) and change CTA to "Download" for clarity. Also add help text for what "score" means.

Maria D: Good. For keyboard a11y — want up/down in table to move focus, space to select row, Cmd/Ctrl+A to select all. Is that OK?

designbot: Accessibility checklist: ensure modal traps focus, first focus = close button, aria-live on export progress.

Akshay: Agree on "Columns" and "Download". Also show a sample row preview in the modal (tiny table) so people know what they're getting. Add a small note: "Exports include top rerank score by default; toggle to include full score history."

Lena: Avoid jargon — "rerank score" is fine but also show tooltip "model relevance score (higher is better)". For large exports (>50k rows) show an email delivery option and note size limits.

Sam (QA): Dev note: CSV should include header row; JSON should be newline-delimited (ndjson). Also need to confirm we include embeddings as base64 or as comma list.

Maria D: Good catch. I propose defaults: CSV with comma-separated floats for embeddings truncated to 6 decimals and a toggle "Include full vectors (may be large)". Also add aria-label: "Export dialog" on modal and aria-describedby for description.

Akshay: Copy suggestion for description: "Choose file format and which columns to download. For large exports, we will email a downloadable link."

Lena: Microcopy for the columns label: "Columns to include in export — uncheck to exclude." Small help link to docs: /docs/exports#vectors

Maria D: Final thing — after export start, show small toast: "Preparing export… we'll email you if it takes longer than 1 minute" and include a link to cancel.

Akshay: :thumbsup: I'll update the Figma and push to dev today.

Sam (QA): I'll add test cases for keyboard nav, ndjson validation, and size limit handling.

Maria D: Thanks team — tagging @akshay for follow-up and @lena for copy review. Ending thread.
